question: For the year 2012, which top 10 evaluation groups have the largest subplot acres when considering only the condition with the largest subplot acres within each group? Please include the evaluation group, evaluation type, condition status code, evaluation description, state code, macroplot acres, and subplot acres.
sql:
-- Alternative: Filter to evaluation groups specifically for 2012
WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    p.state_code,
    c.condition_status_code,
    SUM(c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot) AS subplot_acres,
    SUM(COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 0)) AS macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
    AND c.state_code = p.state_code
  WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
    AND CAST(p.evaluation_group AS STRING) LIKE '%2012'
  GROUP BY 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    p.state_code,
    c.condition_status_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC) AS rn
  FROM condition_acres
),
top_per_group AS (
  SELECT evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, evaluation_type, evaluation_description, state_code, condition_status_code, subplot_acres, macroplot_acres
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT evaluation_group_description AS evaluation_group, evaluation_type, condition_status_code, evaluation_description, 
       CAST(state_code AS STRING) AS state_code, 
       ROUND(macroplot_acres, 2) AS macroplot_acres, 
       ROUND(subplot_acres, 2) AS subplot_acres
FROM top_per_group
ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10
